name: Marco Polo Expediciones - Rentals & Activities
title: Marco Polo Expediciones | Excursions in Benidorm and Costa Blanca
description: En Marco Polo Expediciones somos expertos en alquiler de bibicletas, embarcaciones y excursiones por Benidorm y toda la zona de la Costa Blanca.
paragraphs: We offer our clients the most complete and unique open air adventure thrills they have ever experienced complete with unforgettable moments. Your safety is our most important mission.
We offer you the most exciting activities so you can have the most unforgettable vacations.
Welcome at Marco Polo Expediciones and Marc Paul Dobbelaere (PE graduate, at Brussels University).
Marco Polo Expediciones is the leading company localized in the Costa Blanca, specialised in Outdoor Activities, Events, team building, corporate fun days.

We offer a weekly activity program, to choose from jeep safaris, bicycle trips, kayaking, jet skiing, horse riding, huge catamaran sailing, paintballing, scuba diving, mountain hikes, Nordic Walking and more. We also do tailor made activities for small or larger companies, like nature hikes, remote control sailing boats, African percussion, canyoning paragliding, helicopter and balloon flights but also team building events...we will surely surprise the participants letting them prepare a typical Spanish paella themselves or do a authentic barefoot wine stomp for example! For these groups, like businesses, schools, sports clubs, walk and cycle groups, we can organize the whole arrangement, from the arrival till the departure. This includes air port service, lodging, official guide service and all activities. Age or physical condition poses no problem for us.
